recall_findings.prompt:
Draft iteration {iteration} of 6. You are writing sections of a market research report.

Full outline:
{report_outline}

Sections to draft in order:
1. Executive Summary
2. Market Size & Growth
3. Industry Trends & Drivers
4. Competitive Landscape
5. Customer Segments & Personas
6. Market Entry Barriers + SWOT + Strategic Recommendations

Reply with ONLY the section name for iteration {iteration}.

store_draft.prompt:
Draft iteration {iteration} of 6 complete. Section written: {section_pick}

If iteration is less than 6, reply YES to continue. If iteration is 6, reply NO — all sections are drafted.
